name: Kollapur–Kalwakurthy National Highway
significance: NH 167K is a branch of NH 167. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Kollapur to Kalwakurthy, and it meets NH 167 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 167 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Bandimot to Kodada
